name: Cape hake
description: Cape hakes (Merluccius spp.) - the deep-water predatory cods that anchor Namibia's trawl fishery, the country's most valuable. Life-stage group of the source model's juvenile and adult hake stanzas, measured separately and pooled here because the two stanzas form one population: juveniles filter macrozooplankton while adults prey on fish, squid and smaller hake. Hake are both predator and prey here - seals, sharks, monkfish and bigger hake all take them.
